repo.description:
### Impact

Incorrect path handling with groupfolders caused the admin_audit app to not properly log all actions on files and folders inside groupfolders.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 30.0.9 or 31.0.1
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 30.0.9 or 31.0.1

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/2890071)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/50992)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: admin_audit does not log all actions on files in groupfolders
